annotations.title: Cost to own and run an EV

description: What an electric car costs to run and own: energy cost per 100 km, per year and over the years, plus the comparable new price and the total, in USD. Use it for 'what does an Ioniq 6 cost to run per year' (pass slug and your annual_km) or 'cheapest EV to own over 5 years' (no slug: a ranking). Every figure is an estimate from the model's consumption and an illustrative tariff you can replace; the answer names the price row and what is excluded.

annual_km.description: Kilometres a year (default 15000). For miles, multiply by 1.609.

limit.description: Without slug: models in the ranking (default 10).

locale.description: Language of the answer's text and page links (default en): en.

slug.description: Model slug as search_models returns it (also the last part of the page URL https://sulihuli.com/m/<slug>), e.g. 'hyundai-ioniq-6'. Omit to rank the cheapest to own.

tariff_usd_per_kwh.description: Electricity price in USD per kWh (default 0.19, an illustrative home tariff).

name: get_ownership_cost

model.description: With slug: energy per 100 km, per year and over the years, purchase and total in USD, the price row behind it.

models.description: Without slug: the cheapest to own, ranked.

profile.description: annual_km, years, tariff_usd_per_kwh and the tariff date.
